column1: # The reachability witness of 02 §2 is one process run per producer name, with
# only that producer enabled. Seven producers cannot speak under that run for a
# reason that belongs to the EMPTY DOCUMENT rather than to the producer: they
# report on a configuration section, and with no section there is nothing to
# report on. `architecture.layer-violation` needs declared layers, `computed`
# needs a defined metric, `discovery.unmatched-exclude` needs an `exclude:`
# entry, and so on. Leaving them unwitnessed would state "this stand cannot see
# them" where the truth is "this stand handed them an empty document".
# So each of the seven declares the smallest document that makes its subject
# exist. The document is visible here, it is carried into the frozen raw
# observations beside the outcome, and it never touches any probe but the
# witness.
# `channel` closes the attribution hole the envelope would otherwise open. A
# witness run is normally `--only-rule=<producer>` alone, so any finding at all
# is that producer's. `annotation.directive` is the exception: a directive
# addressing a DISABLED rule is not counted as unused, so its witness has to
# enable `complexity.ccn` beside it — and then "the run said something" would
# also be true of the other rule's findings. Where `channel` is given, the
# witness counts only findings whose channel carries that prefix.
# A producer absent from this table is witnessed by the plain run. Presence
# here is not a weaker witness: the producer still has to run and still has to
# report, on the same fixture, in its own channel.
producer
column5: why the empty document is not the question

column1: annotation.directive
column5: an unused directive is only counted against an ENABLED rule, and the fixture's directive addresses complexity.ccn

column1: architecture.layer-violation
column5: without declared layers the rule is a documented no-op

column1: architecture.unassigned-class
column5: the rule ships disabled (`mode: ignore`) and reports against declared layers

column1: computed
column2: {"computed_metrics":{"computed.probe-size":{"description":"a probe metric always above its own warning","formula":"9999","levels":["class"],"warning":1,"error":100000}}}
column5: the producer reports on user-defined metrics, and the fixture defines none

column1: coupling.unmatched-framework-namespace
column5: the rule reports a declared prefix that matched nothing; with no prefix declared there is nothing to report

column1: discovery.unmatched-exclude
column5: the rule reports an `exclude:` entry that matched nothing

column1: suppression.configuration
column5: the rule reports a suppression that named nothing
